rationale: Although the stock is in a strong intraday downtrend trading below both session VWAP ($23.73) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($22.71), the current bid-ask spread of $0.12 (53.2 bps) represents over 40% of the 5-minute ATR ($0.2933). With price already near the bottom of its daily range (8.1% position) and only $0.64 above the session low of $21.91, the wide spread severely degrades the risk-to-reward profile for either a continuation short or a counter-trend bounce with less than an hour until market close.
